text:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a handful of reports from customers and internal QA where the Next starter embed flow (next-embed-demo) ends up in an auth loop after API key rotation. Seems to surface when using SDK v0.9 with streaming + embeddings together.

maria: Ugh. Do you have a repro or a short trace? Which flow is the app using — client-side direct key vs server-side proxy?

alex: Quick repro: clone examples/next-embed, set NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_API_KEY to a short-lived key, run dev, then rotate the key in the dashboard while a streaming embed call is in-flight. Logs show: 

```

ERROR: embedding request failed: 401 Unauthorized
fetch_with_retry: attempt 1 -> 401
stream: aborted by network error while headers already sent

```

Behavior: the client keeps retrying but the streaming pipe never recovers; the UI shows spinner forever.

sam: Short answer: streaming in the JS SDK bypasses the normal retry middleware to avoid duplicating streamed chunks. So when the token is invalid mid-stream we lose the automatic refresh. We intentionally didn't reintroduce retries for streaming in v0.9.

maria: That matches. Are customers doing client-side direct keys? If so that's a separate security concern.

grace: We pushed a small fix to the sample app yesterday that switches the embed call to a server-side proxy + ephemeral token exchange for client use — that avoids mid-stream key rotation problems because the server handles the SDK call. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-examples/pull/412 (draft).

jordan: Workaround for now if you need pure client flow: detect 401 on the stream open, tear down the stream, fetch a fresh ephemeral token from your backend, then re-open stream and resume. Ugly but works. Example server endpoint snippet we used: 

```
// pages/api/embed.js (Next.js)
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js';
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
  const embedding = await client.embeddings.create({ input: req.body.text });
  res.json({ embedding });
}
```

(on the client we call /api/embed and stream results from the server response)

onboard-bot: Ticket created: DE-429 "sdk: streaming should surface token-refresh hooks / fail cleanly on mid-stream 401" assigned to eng-ml. :ticket:

maria: Filing two follow-ups: 1) add an explicit note in the Next starter README about ephemeral token best-practice; 2) add a small code sample showing the server-proxy pattern and the 401->reopen workaround for streaming.

alex: I'll open the PR for the README + example changes and link to DE-429. tagging @sam and @grace for review.

sam: For product/SDK planning — long term we should provide a streaming retry hook or a managed streaming client that can auto-resume from a token refresh checkpoint. I'll add design notes to the SDK parity board. Also flagging that the SDK core team should keep parity between node/browser behaviors re: retries.

grace: Agree. Also adding a small e2e test in the examples CI that simulates key rotation so we don't regress.

alex: thanks everyone. low-priority but high pain in onboarding — will prioritize docs + example change this week. :white_check_mark:
